title: Erdős #1022 OQ-03: Lovász Local Lemma for Property B
description: Extends Erdős #1022 with the Lovász Local Lemma bound for Property B (2-colorability of hypergraphs). Proves: intersection dependency graph structure, element frequency bounds on intersection degree, LLL threshold computation, and the LLL → Property B bridge. The LLL gives much stronger guarantees than the first-moment bound. 1 axiom for the probabilistic LLL step. 21 theorems.

meta.assumptions: 1 axiom: probabilistic LLL step (requires external probability space).

overview.historicalContext: Erdős-Lovász (1975) introduced the LLL for Property B. Spencer's 'Ten Lectures' provides modern treatment.
overview.problemStatement: Prove LLL bound for Property B and the dependency graph structure.
overview.proofStrategy: Define intNeighbors and intersection degree; prove degree bounds; compute LLL threshold; bridge via 1 probabilistic axiom.
